The current MUC-GDN direct-route page lists no operating airline, so the LH relationship must not remain a current nonstop planner edge.
The current MUC-TRS direct-route page lists no operating airline, so the LH relationship must not remain a current nonstop planner edge.
HKG/MAD is explicitly nonstop and both directions are listed. Iberia codeshares beyond Madrid are excluded, as is seasonal Barcelona.
Retain only LH-operated FRA/MUC flight rows. Exclude Munich rail station ZMU, train operator XX and separately operated 4Y entries.
Iberia states it operates direct Madrid-Newark service and describes the Madrid-New York operation. Used only for the explicitly named MAD-EWR route pair; no broader Iberia network is inferred.

Air India official international connectivity map says it flies nonstop to 41 destinations and draws bidirectional arrows between each listed overseas airport and the named Indian airport(s). It is a broad route-universe snapshot, not a current dated timetable; later current advisories and route launches override it where applicable.

Current Air India homepage advisory states all Air India flights to all Middle East destinations are suspended. Middle East pairs shown on the February route map are therefore not inserted as current positive route evidence in this round.
SWISS' current nonstop flightplan lists LX64 ZRH-MIA and LX65 MIA-ZRH without a partner-operator label. No recurring dated validity horizon is inferred from the live flightplan.

LOT's current first-flight page explicitly calls the listed services inaugural LOT Polish Airlines flights and gives directional LOT flight identities for WAW-ALA / ALA-WAW, WAW-SFO / SFO-WAW, GDN-BRU / BRU-GDN, GDN-OSL / OSL-GDN, and KRK-ROME/MAD/BCN with their returns. Exact airport codes are accepted only where the additional airline-owned sources below resolve them.

LOT confirms its three new direct Krakow routes to Rome, Barcelona and Madrid launched 2026-03-30 and are part of its year-round network. Reverse directions are accepted only because the separate current first-flight page explicitly publishes return LOT flight identities.

LOT's current Krakow-origin page identifies Krakow-Balice Airport (KRK) and separately lists direct flights to Rome, Barcelona and Madrid. It is used as current direct-route corroboration, not as a complete LOT network index.

LOT's current Madrid surface resolves Madrid to Barajas Airport (MAD) and explicitly says LOT offers direct Krakow-Madrid flights. Used with the separate directional LOT flight identities; it is not a network denominator.
Ethiopian Airlines publishes direct ADD-MRU and MRU-ADD passenger service effective 2026-07-12 with exact ET887/ET886 identities.

TAP's current page is explicitly titled direct non-stop flights and displays exact airport-coded directional pairs. GCMP retains only directions visible on that current non-stop surface; the page is not treated as a complete carrier denominator.

AEGEAN's current flight-status board exposes exact airport pairs and distinguishes rows labeled Aegean Airlines from OlympicAir. GCMP retains only directions explicitly shown as Aegean Airlines on the reviewed current board; OA rows are excluded and no reverse direction is inferred unless separately shown.

Royal Jordanian's Quick Reference Timetable No.473 is explicitly valid 01Sep-30Sep 2026 and publishes exact airport codes, directional flight identities and special From/To AQJ/ADJ rows. Its legend marks one-stop services with * and RO/GF/WY-operated codeshare aircraft with #; the reviewed September flight rows contain no # marker and YYZ is the only * one-stop city row. GCMP retains only exact direct legs that can be represented without decomposing the YYZ through service.
Oman Air announces direct Muscat-Singapore service starting 2026-07-02. Both directions are retained as current route-only evidence.
Oman Air announces direct flights between Muscat and Tashkent starting 2026-06-01. Used as bidirectional current route evidence; weekday schedule is not copied into the dated catalog here.
Oman Air announces a new direct Muscat-Abu Dhabi service starting 2026-07-09. Both directional route rows are retained without inventing a dated timetable horizon.

Oman Air announces direct Muscat-Taif service starting 2026-01-31 and explicitly describes guests flying between Muscat and Taif on Oman Air aircraft. Exact TIF airport identity is resolved by the current Oman Air schedule selector below.

Oman Air's current flight-schedule selector identifies Taif, Saudi Arabia as TIF. It is used only to resolve exact airport identity for the separately published direct Oman Air route, never as a complete route denominator.

Oman Air announces a new direct Muscat-Sochi service starting 2026-07-02, operated year-round by Oman Air Boeing 737-8 MAX aircraft. Exact directions are corroborated by the two current airport-coded route pages below.

Oman Air's current route surface explicitly resolves Muscat (MCT) to Sochi (AER). Combined with the airline-owned direct/operator launch publication; fare inventory alone is not treated as operator evidence.

Oman Air's current 2026 network-expansion release corroborates direct Sochi service from 2026-07-02 and describes a network of up to 49 destinations. The 49-destination marketing count is explicitly not used as a directional route denominator.

Avianca's Summer-2026 transatlantic announcement states Madrid-San Salvador operates four weekly direct frequencies. Used as route-only directional evidence without inventing a dated schedule horizon.

Asiana's current operating-schedule notice lists exact OZ flight-number pairs for a broad 2026 network. GCMP retains only airport pairs whose IATA identity is explicit in the notice. The page itself says other routes may exist and points users to schedule search, so this source is deliberately partial and cannot establish an OZ denominator.

Shenzhen Airlines' current 2026 international coupon terms require flights sold by ZH and actually operated by ZH, explicitly exclude codeshares, and enumerate applicable directional international routes for 2026-08-23..09-23 and 2026-10-04..12-31. GCMP retains the exact airport-resolved routes only; coupon dates do not become recurring schedule evidence.
